drhp.business: The company manufactures PVC pipes, HDPE pipes, CPVC fittings, moulding fittings, CPVC pipes and roto water tanks, and also trades in related products. It sells compound/dry blend and RM compound alongside its own pipe and fitting production, and also earns income from sale of services.

litigation.note: SEBI proceedings against the company and its directors (Mr. Sanjay Kumar Agrawal and Mr. Vijay Prasad Pappu) restricting capital-market access were partly set aside by the Securities Appellate Tribunal (SAT), which remitted the matter back to SEBI; SAT's later order quashed directions against the company and directors; SEBI has filed a review application and the matter remains pending before SAT as of the Board's Report. SAT also directed the company to call back a book-entry loan (outstanding GDR proceeds) from Tapti Pipes & Products Limited FZE into its Indian bank account under Audit Committee supervision; the company has filed an appeal before SAT, Mumbai. Read in the Board's Report (Auditors section).
